PHASE.NAME: RTK First-Class Proxy Shortcuts
PHASE.GOAL: Add RTK-style first-class Synapse commands for common token-heavy tools so agents can use concise commands without remembering syn proxy --.

STEPS.step-1: Expose read, ls, tree, find, rg, grep, git, cargo, npm, pnpm, npx, and pytest command variants with shared RTK proxy flags.
STEPS.step-2: Implement thin shortcut delegation to ProxyCmd so filtering, route preview, evidence, tracking, and exit-code behavior stay unified.
STEPS.step-3: Dispatch RTK shortcut commands to their native executable prefixes.
STEPS.step-4: Verify syn read --evidence filters stdout while raw evidence preserves complete output.
